summary: QMMM Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignations of two directors. Independent director Kwok Wai Lui resigned effective September 30, 2026, also vacating the compensation committee chair and audit and nominating committee seats. Executive director, board chairman, and chief executive Bun Kwai resigned effective October 1, 2026. Both cited personal reasons, denying any dispute or disagreement with the Company. The Board has begun a search for qualified replacements and expects to announce appointments after that process concludes. Watch for a CEO vacancy, interim leadership, and any Nasdaq compliance or disclosure follow-up.
